name: Galbot
summary: Galbot (Galaxy General Robotics) was founded in Beijing in May 2023 by Peking University professor Wang He. It builds wheeled humanoid mobile manipulators and embodied AI models.
funding: Over $300 million round in December 2025 at about $3 billion valuation, about $800 million raised in total by then (The Robot Report); a further RMB 2.5 billion round in March 2026 (Caixin).

sources.title: Galbot brings in $300M to scale mobile manipulator deployments
